mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1800 units, indicating strengthening demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1800, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing, investment, and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the tightening labor market leads to increased wages, consumption, and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between labor market and consumption
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter, indicating reduced supply chain pressures, leads to decreased inflation expectations, lower discount rates, and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO declines > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a high and rising GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, leading to increased corporate earnings, and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between GDP and corporate earnings
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 is high and rising.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth rate exceeds 3% in a quarter, the hawkish monetary stance leads to decreased consumption, investment, and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL growth > 3% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low and stable unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4%, indicating a strong labor market, leads to increased consumer confidence, spending, and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, always.
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between unemployment and consumer confidence
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE is low and stable.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% in a quarter and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1600 units, the strong demand indicators lead to increased economic growth, corporate earnings, and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 5% in 1 quarter and HOUST > 1600
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between demand indicators and economic growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
